simple.meaning: חַשְׁמֹנָה (Chashmônâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “Chasmonah , a place in the Desert.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חַשְׁמֹנָה (H2832) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 33:29, with occurrences in Numbers.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חַשְׁמֹנָה (H2832) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חַשְׁמֹנָה (H2832) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: חַשְׁמֹנָה (Chashmônâh) / H2832 is traced through Numbers 33:29, Numbers 33:30 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
